principles: Benchmark data is user-managed and imported from local files under HARNESS_DATA_DIR/benchmarks.
Tablex never stores Kaggle credentials, API tokens, connector secrets, or production write credentials.
The v0 importer profiles one primary table as a DatasetSnapshot and stores a manifest for supporting tables.

datasets.name: Home Credit Default Risk
datasets.license_note: Kaggle competition terms apply. Download with a user-managed Kaggle account outside Tablex.
recommended_uses: multi-table feature recipe development
credit-risk leakage and prediction-time availability checks
evaluation sanity checks for imbalanced binary classification
agent task contracts that need joins, aggregation, and reportable assumptions

primary_table.description: Main labeled application table used for v0 profiling and baseline setup.

recommended_files.description: Previous credits reported to credit bureau.
POS and cash loan monthly balance history.

datasets.evaluation_notes: Use application_train.csv for local labeled evaluation. Avoid leaking application_test.csv into feature engineering. Prefer stratified or group-aware validation once row/entity semantics are confirmed.
risk_notes: Credit outcomes are time-sensitive; random splits can overstate production performance.
Supporting tables may contain post-application information unless prediction-time availability is verified.

datasets.name: Home Credit Credit Risk Model Stability
datasets.license_note: Kaggle competition terms apply. Download with a user-managed Kaggle account outside Tablex.
recommended_uses: multi-table parquet ingestion stress tests
temporal stability and drift-sensitive evaluation design
agent planning for feature recipe selection under many relational tables

primary_table.description: Base train table. The competition also supplies many depth-0/1/2 relational feature tables.

recommended_files.description: Parquet train tables for relational features.
Nested parquet train tables when extracted with directory structure.
CSV train tables when using the CSV archive.

datasets.evaluation_notes: Prefer time-aware stability evaluation when date_decision is available. The v0 importer only profiles the base table; relational feature generation should be an AgentTask with a manifest of supporting tables.
risk_notes: Dataset scale can exceed local memory if all supporting files are eagerly copied.
Stability metrics need explicit validation windows rather than a single random split.

datasets.name: IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection
datasets.license_note: Kaggle competition terms apply. Download with a user-managed Kaggle account outside Tablex.
recommended_uses: fraud benchmark with severe class imbalance
join handling between transaction and identity tables
leakage checks around transaction time and identity availability
datasets.evaluation_notes: Use stratified validation at minimum. Time-based validation with TransactionDT is more realistic if the task is framed as forward fraud detection.
risk_notes: Identity fields are sparse and may be unavailable for all transactions.
Class imbalance makes accuracy and uncalibrated threshold metrics misleading.

datasets.name: Store Sales - Time Series Forecasting
datasets.license_note: Kaggle competition terms apply. Download with a user-managed Kaggle account outside Tablex.
recommended_uses: time-split and forward validation design
lag, rolling, calendar, holiday, oil price, and store metadata feature recipes
forecasting report and visualization workflows
datasets.evaluation_notes: Use time_split or rolling-origin validation. Random splits are a sanity check only and should not be the primary evaluation spec for forecasting.
risk_notes: Promotions, holidays, and external covariates require careful prediction-time availability checks.
Hierarchical aggregation choices change the business meaning of the metric.

datasets.name: M5 Forecasting - Accuracy
datasets.license_note: Kaggle competition terms apply. Download with a user-managed Kaggle account outside Tablex.
recommended_uses: hierarchical forecasting dataset preparation
wide-to-long transformation AgentTasks
forecast visualization and report stress tests

primary_table.description: Wide daily sales matrix. A feature recipe should transform d_* columns to long format before modeling.

datasets.evaluation_notes: The v0 profiler can inspect the wide table, but baseline training should first create a long-format dataset and a forecast horizon split.
risk_notes: Wide daily columns require transformation before standard tabular baselines.
Hierarchical evaluation requires metric definitions that are not captured by a simple random split.

datasets.name: Rossmann Store Sales
datasets.license_note: Kaggle competition terms apply. Download with a user-managed Kaggle account outside Tablex.
recommended_uses: fast local time-series smoke tests
store-level group leakage checks
lag and calendar feature recipe development
datasets.evaluation_notes: Prefer time_split by Date. Random split is only a coarse smoke test because it mixes future and past observations.
risk_notes: Closed stores and zero sales need explicit target and row inclusion assumptions.
Store metadata must be joined without using future information.

datasets.name: Instacart Market Basket Analysis
datasets.license_note: Kaggle competition terms apply. Download with a user-managed Kaggle account outside Tablex.
recommended_uses: multi-table entity history and aggregation features
group-aware validation by user_id/order history
agent-planned candidate generation for recommendation-like tabular tasks

primary_table.description: Train order-product rows with reordered target.

recommended_files.description: Order metadata including user_id and evaluation set.

datasets.evaluation_notes: Prefer group-aware validation by user_id after joining orders.csv. The v0 primary-table import cannot infer user_id until the supporting table is used.
risk_notes: Order history features must not include the target order itself.
The primary table alone is insufficient for realistic user-level validation.

datasets.name: UCI Bank Marketing
datasets.license_note: Use according to the UCI repository terms and source dataset citation.
recommended_uses: fast local smoke test without Kaggle competition setup
categorical preprocessing and target-profile checks
question/assumption UX checks on a compact business dataset

primary_table.description: Full bank marketing table. Semicolon-separated CSV is handled by DuckDB read_csv_auto.

download.command: Download from UCI, extract bank.zip, and place bank-full.csv under data/benchmarks/uci_bank_marketing/

datasets.evaluation_notes: Use stratified validation for the y target. Treat duration carefully because it is often unavailable before a call is completed.
risk_notes: The duration column can be leakage depending on the prediction framing.
Class imbalance is moderate and should be visible in target profile.
